description: Turn a saved client scenario into a public, branded, shareable URL (https://app.rateapi.dev/r/TOKEN) that anyone can view without logging in. Returns a token and url. The link shows the client name, scenario inputs, and the ranked comparison with a "Powered by RateAPI" footer. Use revoke_share to disable a link later.

scenario_id.description: The saved scenario id to mint a share link for. Required.

name: generate_share_link

outputSchema.description: A public, revocable share link minted for one saved scenario.

token.description: Share token — pass to revoke_share to disable the link.

url.description: Public URL of the hosted report (app.rateapi.dev/r/<token>).
